in_marathi.name: Chinmoy
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Consciousness, Intelligence, Sensation
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chinmoy हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chinmoy is derived from the Sanskrit word 'chinmaya', which means 'consciousness' or 'intelligence'. This name is often used in Hinduism for boys and represents the deep inner wisdom and sensation that exists within each of us.
